scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test:unit:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:test:api && find apps/api/dist-test/test -type f -name '*.test.js' ! -name '*.integration.test.js' -print0 | xargs -0 node --test
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace @easygen/auth-contract && npm run test:unit --workspace @easygen/web && npm run test:unit:api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run build:test:api && find apps/api/dist-test/test -type f -name '*.integration.test.js' -print0 | xargs -0 node --test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && node --env-file=.env --watch apps/api/dist/main.js
